[EN] These cultists aren't giving up! We'll need to eliminate all of them!

Start with the {@LinkCreature:25#2061#devan vanguards} and {@LinkCreature:25#2081#caiman scavengers}. They may not look tough, but they're definitely troublesome.
[ES] ¡Estos cultistas no se van a rendir! ¡Tendremos que eliminarlos a todos!

Empieza con los {@LinkCreature:25#2061#devan vanguards} y los {@LinkCreature:25#2081#caiman scavengers}. Puede que no parezcan fuertes, pero sin duda son muy molestos.

[EN] That's a good-sized dent in their numbers. Sometimes I wonder if we'll ever have an assignment that ISN'T killing cultists.
[ES] Es un buen golpe a sus números. A veces me pregunto si alguna vez tendremos una misión que NO sea matar cultistas.
